module: "AdditionalInfo" section of the Mission Editor: edits the author, the creation or update date (Unix timestamp), the "As Scenario" and "DEV Mission" options, the mission's additional attributes (difficulty, etc., listed by gameplay_missions_missions.getAdditionalAttributes, some in automatic mode) and the grouping in the big map (Group Id, Group Label). Also provides a window that bulk-updates the date of several missions. The module returns a constructor.
notes: The date is an integer (seconds since 1970); os.date('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') is used to display it.
Missions with the same Group Id are grouped in the bigmap; empty = no group.
Issues detected by getMissionIssues: missing difficulty, missing author, missing date (error), group label without translation (minor), DEV mission in a shipping_build version (error).
The date update popup offers by default the missions whose date is later than now minus 2,629,743 s (about one month).
The file contains a local function todToTime (time of day as hh:mm:ss) that is unused in this file.

init.desc: Constructor: remembers missionEditor, names the section "AdditionalInfo" and loads the additional attributes and their sorted keys.

setMission.desc: Selects the mission: finds its instance (gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionById) and creates the buffers for Group Id, Group Label, author and date.

updateDateHumanReadable.desc: Computes, only once, the mission's readable date (format YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss) and caches it.

getMissionIssues.desc: Calls setMission then returns this section's issues (difficulty, author, date, group label translation, DEV mission in release).

draw.desc: Draws the fields Author, Date (with "Now" button), As Scenario, DEV Mission, the additional attributes dropdowns, Group Id and Group Label.

timeUpdaterPopup.desc: Draws the bulk update popup: you choose an "After" date and a "Set To" date, the list of affected missions is displayed (a click removes one), and "Update Affected Missions" writes the new date into each mission, marking it _dirty. The popup's data is cleared when it closes.
